name: alert-trust-core
description: Interactive self-check of the alert chain (collect, write, query, evaluate, route, receive): env profile, read-only snapshot, metric-source check, coverage gaps, timing contracts with fix options, rule review, and component packs for Prometheus, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana Alerting and Alertmanager; aggregates the database and host plugins (alert-trust-<db>) when installed
